verdict.rationale: Claude's first-party Research feature works agentically, running multiple searches that build on each other and deciding what to investigate next, then returns thorough answers with easy-to-check citations. Cowork also advertises delivering synthesized research as finished work. One community user says it 'works pretty nicely for research'; another finds ChatGPT and Gemini deeper on generic research, a quality comparison rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the breadth of sources and the report-style output format, independent hands-on corroboration of citation quality, and evidence that research depth is competitive.
